cli.description: Check Hugging Face Transformers v4 code (scripts, notebooks, dependency files) for v5: fix what can be fixed mechanically, report the rest. Nothing is changed unless --write is given.
cli.epilog: exit codes: 0 nothing at or above --fail-on, 1 something found, 2 usage error or no files to check
help.write: apply the automatic fixes to .py and .ipynb files (default: only show a diff)
help.output: write the report to FILE instead of standard output
help.no_diff: text format: do not print the diff preview
help.color: colored text output (default: auto; NO_COLOR is respected)
help.select: only these rule ids or prefixes, comma separated (for example TV5R,TV5M01)
help.ignore: skip these rule ids or prefixes, comma separated
help.fail_on: exit with 1 when a finding has at least this severity (default: error)
help.exclude: skip files or directories matching this glob (repeatable)
help.list_rules: print the rule table and exit
help.lang: output language (default: TRANSFORMERS_V5_MIGRATE_LANG, then LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG)
help.help: show this help message and exit
err.no_paths: give at least one file or directory to check (or use --list-rules)
note.no_targets: nothing to check: none of the given files is a file kind this tool reads
sec.fixes_dry: Auto-fixable (nothing was changed; add --write to apply)
list.title: Rules (verified against transformers {version})
list.col.title: WHAT IT CATCHES
hint.default: It has no drop-in replacement in v5: delete it and check the migration guide.
hint.logging_dir: Set the TENSORBOARD_LOGGING_DIR environment variable instead.
hint.tpu_num_cores: Set the TPU_NUM_CORES environment variable instead.
hint.ray_scope: Set the RAY_SCOPE environment variable instead.
hint.warmup_ratio: `warmup_steps` takes the ratio as a float in [0, 1), but the value here is not such a literal: check it, then pass it as `warmup_steps`.
hint.warmup_steps_conflict: `warmup_steps` is already set here: keep only one of the two and pass the ratio as a float in [0, 1).
hint.include_inputs_for_metrics: Use `include_for_metrics=["inputs"]` (a list of strings in v5) when it is true, and drop it when it is false.
msg.dup: `{old}` should become `{new}` but `{new}` is already passed: merge them by hand.
msg.TV5R02: `use_auth_token` is not handled any more: use `token`.
msg.TV5R04: `train(model_path=...)` was renamed to `resume_from_checkpoint=...`, but the receiver is not a known Trainer variable: rename it by hand.
msg.TV5R06: `warmup_ratio` was removed: pass the ratio as a float to `warmup_steps`.
msg.TV5R08: `encode_plus` and `batch_encode_plus` were removed (AttributeError in v5): call the tokenizer directly.
msg.TV5M01: `{name}=` is no longer a `from_pretrained` argument: pass `quantization_config=BitsAndBytesConfig({name}=True)`.
msg.TV5M02: `{name}=` was removed: TensorFlow and Flax weights are no longer loaded by v5.
msg.TV5M03: `{name}` was removed in v5 (TensorFlow/Flax classes and model families without a replacement).
msg.TV5M05: The pipeline task `{task}` was removed in v5.
msg.TV5M06: `{name}` was removed from TrainingArguments in v5. {hint}
msg.TV5M07: `{name}` was removed from the tokenizer base class in v5.
msg.TV5M08: The environment variable `{name}` was removed in v5 and is now ignored.
msg.TV5B01: `from_pretrained` without `dtype`: v5 loads the checkpoint's saved dtype (`auto`) instead of float32.
msg.TV5D02: `{spec}` cannot be installed together with transformers 5.23.0, which needs `{required}`.
title.TV5R08: tokenizer.encode_plus / batch_encode_plus removed: call the tokenizer
title.TV5M03: TensorFlow, Flax and other removed classes
title.TV5M06: TrainingArguments field removed without a mechanical replacement
title.TV5B01: from_pretrained without dtype loads the saved dtype (auto)
title.TV5B02: apply_chat_template returns a BatchEncoding by default
title.TV5D02: huggingface-hub pin conflicts with transformers v5
title.TV5P01: file or cell could not be parsed
fix.TV5R06: Rename to `warmup_steps=` with the same float value.
fix.TV5R07: Use `include_for_metrics=["inputs"]`, or drop the argument when it was False.
fix.TV5M01: Build a `BitsAndBytesConfig` and pass it as `quantization_config=`.
fix.TV5M02: Convert the checkpoint to PyTorch weights first.
fix.TV5M03: Port the code to the PyTorch class if one exists, or stay on transformers 4.x.
fix.TV5M04: Pick the class that matches your task.
fix.TV5M05: Use a task that still exists, or call the model's `generate()` yourself.
fix.TV5M06: Follow the hint in the message, or remove the argument.
fix.TV5M07: Call the tokenizer with `text_target=` or remove the call.
fix.TV5M08: Cache variables: set HF_HOME instead. HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER: delete it (downloads use hf_xet). Others: delete them.
fix.TV5B01: Pass `dtype=torch.float32` to keep the v4 behavior.
fix.TV5B02: Pass `return_dict=False` or `tokenize=False` to keep the old return type.
fix.TV5D01: Relax the pin when you upgrade (for example `transformers>=5`).
fix.TV5P01: Fix the syntax error (or re-save the file as UTF-8), or exclude the file.
hint.warmup_ratio_config: Use `warmup_steps` with the same float value in [0, 1).
